# Atlas Edge

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/cumulus#/atlas-edge`

Real consumers: **1** (imports outside `src/cumulus/docs/` and tests).

The connector between two Atlas nodes, drawn inside the map's SVG. Its treatment reflects the endpoints' lifecycle relative to the layer the player is choosing into.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `AtlasEdgeKind` = `"traveled" \| "open" \| "dim" \| "locked"` | yes | — | Which connector treatment to draw. |
| `x1` | `number` | yes | — | Start x, in the atlas svg's coordinate space. |
| `y1` | `number` | yes | — | Start y, in the atlas svg's coordinate space. |
| `x2` | `number` | yes | — | End x, in the atlas svg's coordinate space. |
| `y2` | `number` | yes | — | End y, in the atlas svg's coordinate space. |

## Usage

An atlas connector line. Render one `AtlasEdge` per connection inside the map's `<svg>`, with the `kind` picking the treatment (traveled / open / dim / locked). Each edge carries its own gradient anchored to its endpoints, so it paints at any orientation — horizontal, vertical, or diagonal.

```tsx
import { AtlasEdge } from "src/cumulus/components/atlas/AtlasEdge";

<svg className="dream-atlas">
  <AtlasEdge kind="open" x1={140} y1={40} x2={452} y2={40} />
</svg>
```
